# Mindhive

> Mindhive is a Malaysian data and AI specialist. It builds data infrastructure, deploys generative AI, and delivers hands-on corporate training in Excel, data analytics, and AI — positioned as a strategic partner in digital transformation rather than a one-off vendor.

## Services

- Generative AI Deployment: backend-to-interface AI systems, including document extraction and workflow automation, custom AI assistants grounded on a client's own data, and production interfaces built for daily adoption.
- Data Warehousing: end-to-end data warehousing, consolidating spreadsheets, ERPs, and sales channels into automated pipelines and single-source-of-truth dashboards.
- Corporate Training: hands-on Excel, Data, and AI training for Malaysian teams, delivered onsite across Malaysia or live online. Training is HRD Corp Claimable through a training partner (Mindhive is not itself a directly registered HRD Corp provider).

## Training pages

- [Training Hub](https://www.mindhive.my/training/): overview of all three training tracks.
- [Excel Training](https://www.mindhive.my/excel-training/): modern formulas, Power Query, PivotTables, and automated reporting.
- [Data Training](https://www.mindhive.my/data-training/): data modelling, Power BI dashboards, and SQL fundamentals.
- [AI Training](https://www.mindhive.my/ai-training/): ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Microsoft 365 Copilot workflows for daily work.

## Products built by Mindhive

- OneGo: multi-channel sales analytics, bringing Shopee, TikTok Shop, and Shopify sales into one dashboard with automatic SKU matching across channels.
- Whizzard: AI form digitisation — turns photographed paper forms into clean, checked, structured data.
- Smart Tahfiz: end-to-end management system for tahfiz schools, tracking hafazan progress, attendance, and role-based access for teachers, admins, and students.
